faq:
Frequently Asked Questions

What does residential interior design in Rajokri include?

Full-home planning, kitchens, wardrobes, bathrooms, ceilings, lighting, flooring, furniture and décor for farmhouses, houses and apartments.

Can you design a home for a large joint family?

Yes. We plan private suites, shared living areas and enough storage for every generation, with space for visiting relatives.

Do you design staff and service areas too?

Yes. Kitchens, utility rooms, staff rooms and service entries are planned so the household runs smoothly.

When is the right time for residential interior design?

Before civil work is finished, so electrical, plumbing and furniture are planned together and nothing needs to be redone.
